# Top Flight Comedy

> Top Flight Comedy is an Austin, Texas comedy production company founded by Austin stand-up comedian Evan Lopez. It produces weekly stand-up shows in East Austin, private speakeasy nights and corporate comedy events. Tagline: "Comedy shows that take flight."

## Key facts
- **Business type:** Live comedy production company
- **Location:** Austin, Texas. Current weekly shows are at East Austin Comedy, 2505 East 6th Street, Suite D, Austin, TX 78702.
- **Founder:** Evan Lopez, Austin stand-up comedian, featured on OFTV's "LMAOF" series (https://evanlopez.com)
- **Current shows:** Hump Day Haha's (weekly), Daywalkers Comedy Show, East Austin Comedy Club Early Show
- **Tickets:** Sold through Eventbrite (https://www.eventbrite.com/o/78517158513). Prices vary by show.
- **Talent:** Austin comics plus touring headliners with credits on Netflix and Comedy Central
- **Known for:** Sold-out shows and five-star reviews

## Services
- [Live comedy shows](https://topflightcomedy.com/#shows): Weekly showcases in East Austin with a fresh lineup every show.
- [Corporate comedy events](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Performances for company parties, conferences and off-sites, clean or edgy lineups, scalable to 500+ guests.
- [Private speakeasy events](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Intimate, limited-capacity shows at private locations.
- [Venue and partner productions](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Recurring comedy nights with restaurants, hotels and clubs.
